summary: Cart changes are link-only: cart link (and cart add alias) builds https://affil.walmart.com/cart/addToCart?items=id|qty,… and prints it; optional --open/--launch opens the user's default browser under the print-by-default harness rules. The link ADDS/increments qty. No CDP/chromedp, no cart update/remove, no slots reserve, no orchestra updateItems/reserveSlotMutation. Reads kept: orders, search, product, store, cart view, slots list.
reason: Thomas decided via Grok Bot: no browser disguise and no CDP browser driving. Writes become LINK-ONLY — CLI turns a list of items into ONE Walmart add-to-cart URL; user opens it and checks out themselves. CLI never mutates the cart. Direct orchestra cart POSTs were dropped by bot protection; affiliate multi-item format confirmed from affil JS (pipe on entry URL, underscore rewrite on page) and anonymous redirect chain.
validated_outcome: Maintainer confirmed multi-item affil link added 3/3 items in a signed-in browser. CLI prints URL by default; --open opt-in; harness refuses launch; no CDP.
